description.value: Thierry is an acclaimed French-inspired artisan chocolaterie and café founded by Maître Chocolatier Chef Thierry Busset, formerly pastry chef at three Michelin three-star restaurants in London and praised by Gordon Ramsay as 'one of the finest pastry chefs in the world.' The Ambleside location on Bellevue Avenue offers handcrafted macarons, seasonal tarts, artisan chocolates, and a lunch menu of fresh sandwiches and quiche made with organic eggs. It is part of the Toptable Group family of Vancouver restaurants and provides both indoor and outdoor seating.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website clearly confirms this is the 'Thierry Ambleside' location at 1343 Bellevue Ave, West Vancouver, with phone 604 912 0700, matching the OSM address. OSM's diet:vegetarian=yes is corroborated by multiple vegetarian items on the website menu (vegetarian quiche, seasonal vegetarian soup, Roasted Tomato + Chevre Sandwich). No bicycle-specific amenities—bike rack, Wi-Fi, water refill—are mentioned anywhere on the website; the only parking reference is car parking 'underneath and in-front of the building.'
concerns: OSM name is 'Thierry' while the business operates as 'Thierry Chocolates' and this branch is styled 'Thierry Ambleside' on the website — minor branding discrepancy, not a substantive issue.
Phone number (604 912 0700) is absent from OSM but confirmed on the website for the Ambleside location; contact_confirmed.phone set to null as OSM had no value to corroborate.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly accessible café-chocolaterie on the West Vancouver waterfront, clearly open and operating with a confirmed web presence and address.
